judged_text: TopicEmbed.import now derives the category from EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url), but when the record is absent (returns false) eh.try(:category_id) yields nil and the topic lands in uncategorized with no logging, unlike the old embed_category default which was an explicit operator setting. Sites that relied on embed_category for feed-embedded topics get all new embeds dumped into uncategorized once a feed URL's host has no EmbeddableHost row, silently changing post placement for every retrieved feed item.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes TopicEmbed.import to set the new topic’s category from `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and passes `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (app/models/topic_embed.rb). If `record_for_host` returns nil/false (e.g., no matching row for the URL’s host), the category argument becomes nil, and there is no explicit fallback or logging in this method. The old global `embed_category` setting is removed (config/site_settings.yml, locales, SiteSetting method removed), so this is a real behavioral edge case created by the change. However, the diff also introduces host gating elsewhere (`EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` used in TopicRetriever and EmbedController), so whether this results in incorrect topic placement depends on call paths not shown; thus it’s a concrete concern but not provably a broken behavior from the diff alone.
